story.title: Our Story — MŌRI Matcha Bar & Culture
story.description: Mori means forest. The story and philosophy behind MŌRI: an urban matcha bar that turns matcha into a small daily ritual.
story.lede: Mori (森) means forest in Japanese. A short, green, easy-to-remember name for a place that wants to make matcha part of everyday life.
story.bannerAlt: MŌRI's travertine bar with daylight coming through the windows
story.nameH: Four letters and a whole forest.
name: We wanted a name that works just as well on a cup, a shopfront and a T-shirt. Mori, Japanese for forest, speaks of matcha's plant origin and the green that fills everything.
The macron over the O is our small detail: it gives the written name character, even though it's pronounced as usual. MO-ri.
We didn't want a solemn tea house or a romantic café. We wanted an urban, fresh place with personality, one that could live in Madrid, Barcelona or any European city.
story.ideaH: Matcha as a break, not a ceremony.
story.idea: The Japanese tea ceremony is beautiful, but it isn't what happens on a Tuesday at nine. MŌRI takes the best of matcha culture and brings it into your routine: a great product, carefully prepared and served without rush, even if you only have ten minutes.

culture.title: Matcha Culture — What matcha is and how it's made · MŌRI
culture.description: Everything about matcha: where it comes from, how it's prepared step by step, ceremonial vs culinary grade and a short glossary.
culture.lede: You don't need to be an expert to enjoy it, but knowing a little makes it even better. Here are the essentials, no solemnity required.
culture.whatH: Green tea, but the whole leaf.
what: Matcha is Japanese green tea ground into a powder. The plants are shaded for a few weeks before harvest, so they produce more chlorophyll and more L-theanine: that's where the deep green and the sweet, umami taste come from.
The leaves are then dried, stripped of stems and veins and slowly ground in stone mills. Unlike regular tea, you don't steep it and throw the leaf away: you drink the whole leaf.

legalNotice.title: Legal notice
legalNotice.description: Who is behind MŌRI, why this site exists and the terms for using it.

sections.title: Who is behind it
body: This site is a portfolio project by srdgz, a web developer. You can see the code and other projects at github.com/srdgz.
MŌRI Matcha Bar & Culture isn't a company, has no tax ID or registered address and offers no real products or services. The Malasaña address, opening hours and prices are made up.

sections.title: Why it exists
body: It shows how a complete online shop is designed and built: menu, accounts, cart, payment, order tracking and a store panel.
Everything works like a real shop, but payments run in Stripe's test mode and no order is ever made or delivered.

sections.title: Using the site
body: Feel free to browse, create an account and place test orders. Please don't enter real card details or sensitive information: you don't need to.
Test accounts and orders may be deleted at any time without notice.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: MŌRI's code, design, logo and copy are the work of the project's author. Photos come from free-to-use stock libraries.
You're welcome to take inspiration from the project, but not to pass it off as a real business.

sections.title: Contact
body: If you have any questions about the project, write to us from the contact page or open an issue in the GitHub repository.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What data this demo shop keeps, what it's used for and how to delete it.

sections.title: Who handles your data
body: The controller is the author of the portfolio project (srdgz). There's no company behind it and data isn't used for any commercial purpose.

sections.title: What we keep
body: If you create an account: your name, email, hashed password and, if you add them, your addresses and favourite drinks.
If you place an order: the contact and delivery details you enter, the drinks and the order status.
Card details never reach our servers: Stripe collects them in test mode.

sections.title: What we use it for
body: Only to make the demo work: signing in, building your order summary, showing its tracking and sending order and account emails.
We don't send marketing, build profiles, or sell or share data with anyone.

sections.title: Who else sees it
body: The services that run the site: Vercel (hosting), Neon (database in Frankfurt), Stripe (test payments) and the email provider that sends messages. Each one only uses it to provide its service.
If you sign in with Google, Google shares your name and email with us.

sections.title: How long
body: For as long as your account exists or until the demo database is cleaned, whichever comes first. Unpaid orders expire after 30 minutes.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can see and change your data in your account and delete it entirely from “Security”. For anything else, write to us from the contact page.
We suggest using a test email: the demo works just the same.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: The only cookies and data this site keeps in your browser and what they're for.

sections.title: Only what's needed
body: This site uses no analytics, advertising or social media cookies. That's why there's no consent banner.

sections.title: What we keep
body: A Better Auth session cookie when you sign in, to remember who you are. It expires when you sign out or after a few days.
Your cart in the browser's local storage, so you don't lose it when you reload.
Stripe may set its own technical cookies on the payment step to prevent fraud.

sections.title: How to delete them
body: You can delete them from your browser settings. If you do, you'll be signed out and your cart will be emptied.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.description: How MŌRI's test orders work: payment, pickup, delivery, cancellation and refunds.

sections.title: A test shop
body: No order placed on this site is a real purchase. Payment uses Stripe's test mode: no money is taken and no drink is made or delivered.
To try the payment, use card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future date and any CVC.

sections.title: Prices
body: Prices are in euros and include 10 % hospitality VAT, shown separately in the order summary.

sections.title: Pickup and delivery
body: You can pick a slot to collect in store or ask for “Envío MŌRI” delivery to postcodes in the delivery area. Delivery has a minimum order and a flat fee, and it's free above a certain amount; you'll see it before paying.

sections.title: Cancellations and refunds
body: The shop can cancel an order until it starts being made; in that case the full amount is refunded.
Once made, drinks can't be returned as they're perishable, unless we got something wrong, in which case we refund it.

sections.title: Tracking
body: After paying you get a link to follow the order live. If you have an account, you'll also see it under “Orders” in your account.
